output.title: Closing line for the Rx education call
output.draft_text:
How to close the Rx education call:

1. Optional: In your own words, you may tell the member that a summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two business days. If you use this, say it before the closing sentences.
2. Read the two closing sentences word for word:
   "[closing sentence 1, exact approved wording]"
   "[closing sentence 2, exact approved wording]"
3. Stop. Do not add anything after the closing sentences.

This closing applies to [which Rx education call types or scripts this closing applies to].
